summary: Retest of iteration_12 nits against the current build — ALL THREE items now verified working. (1) Backend delta caps implemented: GET /api/dashboard/executive?period=month returns ca.delta_pct=87.4 (base July=7470€) and sales.delta_pct=null (prev count=1 < 3). Edge cases verified by injecting temporary sales into the month-2 slot: prev CA=0 -> null, prev CA=500 (<1000€) -> null, prev CA=1500 & count=3 -> numeric deltas; all injected sales + the TEST_QA client were deleted afterwards. (2) 'À traiter' alerts navigate correctly: alert-to_schedule -> /chantiers, alert-commissions -> /commissions, alert-overtime -> /heures-sup (verified with a freshly created pending entry). (3) Overtime reject button exists and works: hovering overtime-cell-Evan-2026-08-20 reveals BOTH overtime-validate-Evan-2026-08-20 (green check) and overtime-reject-Evan-2026-08-20 (red X); clicking reject empties the cell, fires the 'Refusé & retiré' toast, tech card total drops 2.5h -> 0h, and the backend returns {deleted:true} with the entry gone from GET /api/overtime?month=. Dashboard shows no absurd delta pill (only 87.4% on the CA card; Ventes card shows no delta). Iteration_12's failure was indeed a stale bundle/backend. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass, all frontend checks pass.

issues: Reject click fires TWO toasts simultaneously: 'Refusé & retiré' and 'Evan · 0h enregistrée' (the shared onSaved/optimisticUpdate callback also toasts). Cosmetic but contradictory wording — pass a flag to optimisticUpdate to suppress its toast on reject (HeuresSup.jsx L98-100 vs L162).

Validate/reject hover buttons are only 16x16px (h-4 w-4) and sit outside the cell (-top-1 -right-1); very small hit targets and impossible to reach on touch devices (hover-only, opacity-0 group-hover). Consider larger targets or a tap/long-press affordance for mobile.

action_items: Optional polish only: suppress the duplicate '0h enregistrée' toast when the reject button is used.
Optional polish: enlarge the validate/reject hover buttons and provide a non-hover path for touch.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is ~2291 lines — split into routers (dashboard, sales, overtime, commissions) before it grows further.
Thresholds 1000€ / 3 sales are magic numbers inline in _delta/_delta_count; hoist to module constants (or settings) so the product rule is discoverable.
Reject reuses POST /overtime with hours=0 to delete; a dedicated DELETE /overtime/{id} (or /reject) would be more explicit and avoid the shared success toast path.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (delta pills, 3 alert navigations, validate+reject buttons, reject persistence)
